sections.bio:
Most organisations don't have an AI problem. They have a transformation problem.

For more than 20 years, I've helped organisations improve performance by redesigning how they work, empowering their people and embracing technology that delivers measurable business outcomes.

Today, I specialise in helping organisations build Human + AI Workforces—where people and Artificial Intelligence work together to increase productivity, improve decision-making and unlock sustainable growth.

My philosophy is simple: AI shouldn't replace people. It should empower them.

I work with boards, CEOs and leadership teams to turn AI ambition into practical execution by designing operating models, identifying automation opportunities, improving business processes and embedding AI into day-to-day operations.

My expertise includes:
• AI Strategy & Implementation
• Business & Digital Transformation
• Target Operating Model (TOM) Design
• Operational Excellence
• Process Improvement
• Change Leadership
• Commercial Strategy
• Executive Advisory

Throughout my career I've led large operational teams, managed complex logistics environments, delivered organisation-wide transformation programmes and helped businesses navigate change across logistics, healthcare, digital and commercial sectors.

Alongside my consulting work, I'm the Founder of Winnerpreneur, a platform helping entrepreneurs and organisations harness AI through practical tools, implementation frameworks and business education.

I'm also developing innovative AI solutions including RobAI, designed to improve productivity and business performance, and an AI-powered Renters' Rights Platform that helps landlords, letting agents and property professionals navigate the UK's evolving legislation with greater confidence and efficiency.

Beyond consulting, I'm passionate about sharing knowledge. I've delivered talks and workshops on Artificial Intelligence and the Future of Work, including speaking engagements at the University of Oxford and the University of Worcester, helping leaders understand how to adopt AI responsibly and effectively.

I also serve as a Trustee at Citizens Advice Solihull Borough, supporting governance and strategic decision-making while giving back to the community.

The organisations that will lead the next decade won't simply adopt AI—they'll redesign how people and AI work together.

If you're looking for a keynote speaker, AI Transformation Strategist, executive leader or trusted advisor to help your organisation embrace the future of work, I'd love to connect.

sections.title: How I work
sections.body:
# How I Work

I partner with brands that are building the future and help them tell their story through authentic, educational and engaging content.

My approach combines **business insight, AI expertise and creator storytelling** to create content that connects with audiences and drives action.

## 1. Understand the Brand & Audience

Every collaboration starts with understanding your goals:

• Who are you trying to reach?
• What problem does your product solve?
• What message do you want your audience to remember?

I take time to understand your brand voice, values and objectives before creating content.

## 2. Create Strategy-Led Content

I don't believe in simply promoting products.

I create content that educates, inspires and adds value by connecting your brand with real conversations around:

🤖 Artificial Intelligence
🚀 Entrepreneurship
📈 Business Growth
💡 Innovation
⚡ Productivity & Future of Work

The goal is to make your audience curious, engaged and ready to take action.

## 3. Storytelling That Builds Trust

People don't connect with advertisements — they connect with stories.

I create content that shows:

• Why the product matters
• How it solves real problems
• How people can benefit from using it

My focus is creating genuine recommendations rather than transactional promotions.

## 4. Amplify Through My Community

I share content across my platforms to reach professionals, entrepreneurs, founders and technology enthusiasts who are actively looking for ways to grow and improve.

## 5. Measure & Optimise

Successful collaborations are built on results.

I review:

• Engagement
• Audience feedback
• Brand awareness
• Content performance

Then use those insights to improve future campaigns.

---

My philosophy:

**Create value first. Build trust second. Drive results third.**

I help brands turn ideas into conversations and conversations into opportunities.

sections.title: Time from booking to post
sections.body:
# Time From Booking to Post

I aim to make collaborations simple, efficient and seamless.

**Typical turnaround: 7–14 days from booking to published content.**

My process:

**Day 1–2: Discovery & Brief**

* Confirm campaign goals, key messages and deliverables
* Understand your brand, product and target audience

**Day 3–5: Content Creation**

* Develop creative concept and content direction
* Create authentic content aligned with my audience and your objectives

**Day 6–8: Review & Refinement**

* Share content for feedback (where required)
* Make agreed adjustments

**Day 7–14: Publish & Amplify**

* Publish content across agreed channels
* Engage with audience responses
* Share performance insights where applicable

For time-sensitive campaigns, launches or events, I can offer accelerated turnaround options.
